avisos.titulo: The allowance is being phased out
avisos.texto: If you are not on the Social Register of Mauritius, the CSG income allowance is paid only up to June 2027. From July 2026 it is a third of what people on the Register get.

fuente.titulo: Social Contribution and Social Benefits Act 2021, consolidated to Act 14 of 2026, section 30B(3) and Seventh Schedule

avisos.texto: The Finance Act 2026 replaced the phasing in of pension age and created the State Age Pension. The calculator follows the Tenth Schedule of the National Pensions Act as amended on 13 August 2026.

fuente.titulo: The Finance Act 2026 (Act No. 14 of 2026), section 12: National Pensions Act amended
